body:
### Environment
- SGLang `0.5.19.dev410+gedff717ef` (sha `edff717ef`), flashinfer-python 0.6.17
- DeepSeek-V4-Flash (`DeepseekV4ForCausalLM`), `dsv4` attention backend, `flashinfer_mxfp4` MoE runner
- 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (sm_120), TP=2

### Reproduction
```
python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path <DeepSeek-V4-Flash> --tp 2 \
  --speculative-algorithm NEXTN --speculative-num-steps 2 \
  --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 3
```

### Actual
```
  File ".../sglang/srt/server_args.py", line 5689, in _handle_model_specific_adjustments
    apply_deepseek_v4_defaults(self, model_arch)
  File ".../sglang/srt/arg_groups/deepseek_v4_hook.py", line 150, in apply_deepseek_v4_defaults
    assert server_args.speculative_algorithm in (
AssertionError: Only EAGLE and DSPARK speculative algorithms are supported for DeepseekV4ForCausalLM
```
The same command with `--speculative-algorithm EAGLE` starts and loads `DeepseekV4ForCausalLMNextN` as the draft.

### Expected
`--speculative-algorithm` help lists `NEXTN` as a builtin (`server_args.py:2144`; main `:2097`) and the code treats it as a pure alias of EAGLE (`arg_groups/speculative_hook.py:61` returns `"EAGLE"` for `"NEXTN"`; "NEXTN has collapsed to EAGLE", `server_args.py:10163`). NEXTN should behave exactly like EAGLE for DeepSeek-V4.

### Root cause (ordering)
The alias is only resolved inside `handle_speculative_decoding` (`speculative_hook.py:118`, called from `server_args.py:3943`). The DSv4 hook runs earlier, from `_handle_model_specific_adjustments` (`server_args.py:3881` -> `:5689`), and asserts on the raw CLI string (`deepseek_v4_hook.py:149-153`).

Upstream `main` (`2c05ed4e7`, 2026-09-06) is the same by inspection, not re-run: the assert is unchanged at `arg_groups/deepseek_v4_hook.py:147-153` (now reading `cfg.speculative_algorithm`, called from `arg_groups/model_hook.py:177`); alias resolution is still at `speculative_hook.py:69` / `:123`; and `arg_groups/pipeline.py` calls `handle_model_specific_adjustments` (line 237) before `handle_speculative_decoding` (line 320).

### Proposed fix (either)
1. Accept `"NEXTN"` in the hook's allowed tuple and in the `== "EAGLE"` topk check (`:154`), or
2. Hoist the string-only NEXTN->EAGLE normalization ahead of the model-specific hooks so every hook sees the canonical name. Other model hooks may share this pattern (not audited).

Low priority (the V4 cookbook recommends `EAGLE`), but the help text advertises NEXTN. Happy to open a PR for (1) or (2).
title: [Bug] DeepseekV4ForCausalLM hook rejects `--speculative-algorithm NEXTN` because the NEXTN->EAGLE alias is resolved after model-specific hooks
